name: sourcemap
description: Appends a local-only @sourcemap comment to each project file (what it does, which files depend on it), so the agent finds files with its own grep and sees what a change can break when it reads one. Notes are LLM-written in the background and shared through git; the comments never reach git.

settings.name: LLM annotation
settings.description: true (default): qwen writes a one-sentence note per file in the background (roughly one call per 10 files, then only for changed files; notes are committed in .qwen/sourcemap/notes.jsonl, so a team pays once). false: no LLM calls; the comments list dependents only.

settings.name: Exclude patterns
settings.description: Comma-separated gitignore-style globs, relative to the project root, that the sourcemap should skip (.gitignore is already respected). Leave empty for none.

settings.name: OpenAI API logging
settings.description: Set to true to pass --openai-logging to every qwen call the extension makes in the background. Leave empty or false to disable.
